tagline: Safely Delivering Innovative Solutions for Offshore Energy
hero_kpi_rationale: ROV utilization rate is a key indicator of demand in the offshore sector. A 65% utilization in 2025 reflects the health of the deepwater drilling market and the inspection, maintenance, and repair (IMR) services to which Oceaneering provides its remotely operated vehicles.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: The company's revenue increased in 2025 due to growth in the energy sector and improved pricing in energy markets

kpis.name: ROV Utilization
kpis.explanation: Percentage of remotely operated vehicles (ROV) used relative to available capacity
kpis.description: ROV utilization decreased by 2% in 2025 (from 67% to 65%) due to a decline in the average number of floating rigs under contract (from 146 to 137 rigs), reflecting weakening drilling contracts
kpis.signal: Decline in ROV utilization rate in 2025

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income increased by 23.7% in 2025 to $304.6M (versus $246.3M in 2024), driven by revenue growth across all segments and margin improvement amid better pricing conditions
kpis.signal: Significant increase in operating income in 2025
